sourcesEvaluated.doanTrich: MLA Style: MLA Guide to citing generative AI Following the guidelines in section 1.7 of the MLA Handbook, the format is as follows: Title of source (describe what was generated) AI tool Version Publisher Date created Location (general URL) For example: Fabric print of farm animals, Midjourney ver 5.2, Midjourney Inc., 18/07/2023, https://www.midjourney.com/home

sourcesEvaluated.doanTrich: Note Use of AI is fraught with complications involving accuracy, bias, academic integrity, and intellectual property and may not be appropriate in all academic settings. This guide is meant more for academic researchers looking to utilize AI tools in their research. Students are strongly advised to consult with their instructor before using AI-generated content in their research or coursework.
